verdict.rationale: Bento's SDK docs say it maintains first-party packages for JavaScript, Ruby, PHP, Laravel, WordPress, WooCommerce, and Next.js, and list a wider set of SDKs (Python, Go, .NET, Rust, Swift, and others). A Postman collection covers every endpoint, and Bento Skills tells AI agents when to use an SDK versus MCP or the CLI. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the SDKs work well; clarity on which of the 15 listed SDKs are official, since only seven are explicitly called first-party; evidence of in-depth per-SDK reference docs.
